ActivationPredicate.description:
A boolean answer-root gate for a projected field.

The answer-root and plan-value authorities are embedded in the execution
plan, so this contract stores only the typed answer-root reference and the
expected boolean.  The envelope closes the reference through those
authorities before hand-off.
ActivationPredicate.title: ActivationPredicate

AuthoritativeResolution.description: Strict item-scoped resolver output; root identifiers are not accepted.
AuthoritativeResolution.title: AuthoritativeResolution

ClarificationSlot.description: One user-answerable semantic axis; no internal JSON patch path leaks.
ClarificationSlot.title: ClarificationSlot

CompiledAnswerContract.description: Canonical v1 answer contract for a ready or partial-ready turn.
CompiledAnswerContract.title: CompiledAnswerContract

CompiledAnswerItem.description: One atomic user promise and its complete field-level coverage.
CompiledAnswerItem.title: CompiledAnswerItem

CompiledPremiseContract.description: Compiler-owned verification contract for a user premise.
CompiledPremiseContract.title: CompiledPremiseContract

CorrectionLineageChange.description: One source-proven changed coordinate in a correction lineage.
CorrectionLineageChange.title: CorrectionLineageChange

CorrectionLineageDateRoles.description: Internal date sidecar; public v0.4 fields keep their original schema.
CorrectionLineageDateRoles.title: CorrectionLineageDateRoles

CorrectionLineageResolution.description:
Canonical original-to-correction lineage, with no answer values.

``answer_role`` lets one history lineage close the amount and its stated
change reason without inventing a second event identity.  It is a role of
the question topology, never a question-id dispatch key.
CorrectionLineageResolution.title: CorrectionLineageResolution

CoveragePartition.description:
Coverage sets for a projection's required field IDs.

``qualified`` fields intentionally occur in both ``executable`` and
``limited``.  The overlap is closed against the projection field binding
by :class:`CompiledAnswerItem`; this model only owns the required-union
invariant and list-level uniqueness.
CoveragePartition.title: CoveragePartition

DocumentAttributeEvidence.description:
One text attribute proven by one exact disclosure coordinate.

The payload deliberately excludes extracted text and answer-root IDs.  A
relative document role closes cross-document chronology without making a
question ID, field surface, or known receipt a generic routing key.
DocumentAttributeEvidence.title: DocumentAttributeEvidence

DocumentCollectionResolution.description:
Generic source authority for returning a company's document set.

The resolver supplies only the company coordinate, corpus cutoff, and a
proof that the selector is source-backed.  It deliberately carries no
invented field list and no document answer values; those belong to the
task result addressed by the whole-target binding.
DocumentCollectionResolution.title: DocumentCollectionResolution

DocumentFactComparisonResolution.description:
Two ordered, same-issuer monetary document facts.

The model owns only generic source coordinates and proof identities.  It
deliberately has no extracted amounts, answer-root IDs, or answer text.
DocumentFactComparisonResolution.title: DocumentFactComparisonResolution

DocumentFactOperand.description:
One source coordinate for a generic document-fact comparison.

This is a proof coordinate, not an extracted answer value.  The source
class is intentionally open-ended so the same lowering can compare any
two document-reported monetary facts.  The relation between the two
operands (issuer, identity and uniqueness) is closed by the enclosing
resolution and by the item-level validator.
DocumentFactOperand.title: DocumentFactOperand

DocumentReasonEvidence.description: A text-evidence coordinate bound to one comparison operand.
DocumentReasonEvidence.title: DocumentReasonEvidence

DocumentReasonEvidenceResolution.description: One source-bound text proof for the comparison's conditional reason.
DocumentReasonEvidenceResolution.title: DocumentReasonEvidenceResolution

DocumentVersionHistoryResolution.description: One annual filing's correction lineage, without a legacy projection.
DocumentVersionHistoryResolution.title: DocumentVersionHistoryResolution

EventAmountChangeResolution.description:
One selected canonical contract observed at two explicit timepoints.

The user supplies the missing company, observation points, amount axis and
canonical root receipt through the clarification protocol.  Those values
remain resolver authority; the compiler owns the two reads and the
``difference`` derivation.
EventAmountChangeResolution.title: EventAmountChangeResolution

EventAmountObservationProof.description: One canonical numeric KRW field that existed at an observation point.
EventAmountObservationProof.title: EventAmountObservationProof

EventCollectionMember.description:
One exact canonical identity admitted to a list result.

``matched_receipts`` are the observations that made this identity satisfy
the collection predicate.  They are intentionally distinct from the
root receipt: a lifecycle query can select a termination observation while
preserving its original contract identity.
EventCollectionMember.title: EventCollectionMember

EventCollectionResolution.description:
Canonical event identities for a multi-row event answer.

This is a source coordinate only.  It carries neither event values nor a
fixture-shaped result; each member is lowered into an exact event-key task
and Stage2 performs the field reads.
EventCollectionResolution.title: EventCollectionResolution

ExecutionPlanValueRoot.description:
Typed registry entry for a plan-internal proof value.

Plan-value roots are deliberately separate from ``ExecutionAnswerRoot``.
They can prove an intermediate value (including a boolean predicate), and
may mirror a user answer root only through an exact bidirectional link.
ExecutionPlanValueRoot.title: ExecutionPlanValueRoot

FieldOutputSpec.description: 서식형 Tool 결과의 한 slot을 계산 가능한 output으로 연결한다.
FieldOutputSpec.title: FieldOutputSpec

FinancialComparisonOperand.description:
One typed financial fact used by a comparison lowering.

Operands are deliberately not answer roots.  They are source-side facts
consumed by compiler-owned ``argmax``/``absolute_difference`` derivations.  The
explicit tag keeps this branch closed when it is embedded in a
``FinancialComparisonResolution``.
FinancialComparisonOperand.title: FinancialComparisonOperand

FinancialComparisonResolution.description: Tagged multi-fact resolution owned by the comparison compiler path.
FinancialComparisonResolution.title: FinancialComparisonResolution

FinancialConcept.description:
agent 가 조회할 수 있는 개념. **정본 사전이 아는 것의 부분집합이다.**

여기에 이름을 올리면 ``agent/planning.py`` 의 ``_canonical_account_aliases``
가 ``src/ingest/account_map.tsv`` 에서 그 개념의 표기를 전부 끌어온다 —
표면형을 손으로 적지 않는다. 개념마다 회계 축을 ``_CONCEPT_AXES`` 에
**함께** 올려야 한다. 축이 없으면 기본값(duration·PL)이 붙어 조용히 틀린다.

``non_controlling_interests``·``owners_of_parent`` 은 **자본 잔액만**
가리킨다 (BS·instant). 예전에는 한 account_norm 에 세 값이 섞여 있어
등록하지 못했는데, XBRL 요소 ID 가 이미 셋을 가르고 있었다 — 적재의
``acode_map.tsv`` 에 손익 쪽 코드가 없어 표기 사전으로 흘러 합쳐진 것이다
(이슈 #127). 이제 넷이 따로 있다.

====================================  ==========  ==================
개념                                  표          뜻
====================================  ==========  ==================
non_controlling_interests             BS instant  자본 잔액
net_income_non_controlling            IS/CI       귀속 당기순이익
comprehensive_income_non_controlling  CI          귀속 총포괄손익
owners_of_parent                      BS instant  자본 잔액
net_income_owners_of_parent           IS/CI       귀속 당기순이익
comprehensive_income_owners_of_parent CI          귀속 총포괄손익
====================================  ==========  ==================
FinancialConcept.title: FinancialConcept

HoldingDisclosureResolution.description: Exact issuer/reporter/effective-filing authority for one holding read.
HoldingDisclosureResolution.title: HoldingDisclosureResolution

HoldingSlotBinding.description:
One requested holding field bound to a canonical DART coordinate.

The binding contains no answer value.  It only freezes the user-facing
field order and the ACODE/slot that Stage2 must read from the exact filing.
HoldingSlotBinding.title: HoldingSlotBinding

LifecycleCompositeAttribute.description: One exact canonical field participating in an event lifecycle answer.
LifecycleCompositeAttribute.title: LifecycleCompositeAttribute

LifecycleCompositeResolution.description: One proven event lifecycle, without values or fixture coordinates.
LifecycleCompositeResolution.title: LifecycleCompositeResolution

LimitationProvenance.description: Resolver-side provenance for a field-level typed limitation.
LimitationProvenance.title: LimitationProvenance

NarrativeMatrixCell.description: One grounded company/document/topic coordinate for narrative fan-out.
NarrativeMatrixCell.title: NarrativeMatrixCell

NarrativeMatrixResolution.description: Bounded internal matrix; public QueryPlan still carries normal tasks.
NarrativeMatrixResolution.title: NarrativeMatrixResolution

PeriodicDocumentNarrativeResolution.description:
Coordinates/provenance for one periodic-document narrative retrieval.

This branch intentionally carries no extracted investment values.  The
document and narrative proofs identify the exact source that the two
execution tasks must use; field-level coverage is a typed resolver
authority that the compiler must preserve.
PeriodicDocumentNarrativeResolution.title: PeriodicDocumentNarrativeResolution

PeriodicNarrativeComparisonResolution.description:
Two ordered report coordinates for a generic open narrative compare.

This payload is deliberately coordinate-only: it carries neither extracted
report text nor a proposed comparison answer.
PeriodicNarrativeComparisonResolution.title: PeriodicNarrativeComparisonResolution

PeriodicNarrativeDocument.description: One exact periodic document and its ordered narrative coordinates.
PeriodicNarrativeDocument.title: PeriodicNarrativeDocument

PeriodicNarrativeEvidence.description:
One report-section coordinate for a user comparison axis.

The coordinate contains no extracted prose. ``source_field_index`` binds
the section to the ordered semantic field; the one remaining final field
is compiled as the cross-axis synthesis field.
PeriodicNarrativeEvidence.title: PeriodicNarrativeEvidence

PresentationSpec.description: 정답 의미를 바꾸지 않는 composer 출력 형식 힌트.
PresentationSpec.title: PresentationSpec

ProjectionField.description: One user-requested output field and its exclusive binding.
ProjectionField.title: ProjectionField

PublicEventSelectorFacets.description: User-visible event selector facets with exact canonical field proofs.
PublicEventSelectorFacets.title: PublicEventSelectorFacets

ResolutionSourceProof.description: A non-user-facing proof tied to one source receipt.
ResolutionSourceProof.title: ResolutionSourceProof

SelectedEventResolution.description:
One canonical event selected by a user-visible event receipt.

``root_receipt`` keeps the canonical event identity.  ``selector_proof``
may instead cite an exact correction/termination observation named by the
user.  The compiler emits the canonical key plus that existing public
seed coordinate, so Stage2 can read the requested observation without
pretending it is the event root.
SelectedEventResolution.title: SelectedEventResolution

SemanticIntent.description: Normalized v1 semantic intent with deterministic local identifiers.
SemanticIntent.title: SemanticIntent

Stage1ReadyEnvelope.description:
Strict, typed Stage1 v1 hand-off.

``status`` and ``completion`` are derived from the embedded contract.  The
public builder accepts optional caller copies only to compare them against
the derived values; it never lets a caller choose a clarification,
terminal, or technical status for this envelope.
Stage1ReadyEnvelope.title: Stage1ReadyEnvelope

Stage1ResolutionDecision.description: Digest-bound resolver result before deterministic plan compilation.
Stage1ResolutionDecision.title: Stage1ResolutionDecision

SupportRequirement.description: System support needed for a field, without becoming a user field.
SupportRequirement.title: SupportRequirement

TaskVerificationRef.description: 값 하나가 아니라 task 실행 결과의 존재·상태를 검증하는 참조.
TaskVerificationRef.title: TaskVerificationRef

WholeTargetBinding.description:
Compiler-owned binding for the requested target object itself.

This is deliberately not a user-named ``ProjectionField``.  Its identifier
is derived from source item order and it carries no invented display key or
surface.  The exact source target remains authoritative through the bound
``SemanticIntent`` and ``source_intent_digest``.
WholeTargetBinding.title: WholeTargetBinding
